                # A short page ends the scan on purpose: the warehouse contract says only the last page is short, and next_cursor on a short page is stale and must not be followed (WMS-30).

new='''            # The cursor, not the page size, decides when the scan ends: the

        return items'''

def test_short_middle_page_with_cursor_is_followed():
    feed = ScriptedFeed({
        (None, 2): Page((item("A"), item("B")), "c1"),
        ("c1", 2): Page((item("C"),), "c2"),
        ("c2", 2): Page((item("D"), item("E")), None),
    })
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available("treasury")
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
    assert feed.calls == [("treasury", None, 2), ("treasury", "c1", 2), ("treasury", "c2", 2)]


def test_repeated_cursor_stops_the_scan():
    feed = ScriptedFeed({
        (None, 2): Page((item("A"),), "c1"),
        ("c1", 2): Page((item("B"),), "c1"),
    })
    rows = InventoryClient(feed).list_available("retail")
    assert [row.sku for row in rows] == ["A", "B"]
EOF
